speed_sub: Measures download and upload speed through Cloudflare
speed_err_failed: The test couldn't finish. Check your connection and try again.
speed_err_no_result: The test ended without a result.
bb_good: Calls, games and video stay smooth even while something is downloading.
bb_ok: A little extra lag while the line is busy. Most calls and games are fine.
bb_bad: Noticeable lag while the line is busy: video calls may stutter and games may lag when someone downloads or uploads.
bb_worse: Heavy lag while the line is busy. This is usually the router's queue (bufferbloat). Turning on SQM or QoS on the router, or asking the provider, usually fixes it.
